camel_example: aliyun sas SubmitCheck --region cn-hangzhou --ScanRange POLICY --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1 --TaskSource YAO_CHI
description_en: Submits a cloud service configuration check
kebab_example: aliyun sas submit-check --scan-range POLICY --task-source YAO_CHI --resource-directory-account-id 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitCheck

parameters.help_en:
The scan range. Valid values:
FULL: scans all check items
POLICY: scans custom-configured check items
parameters.help_zh:
检查范围，取值：
FULL：扫描所有检查项
POLICY：扫描自定义配置的检查项
parameters.name: scan_range

parameters.help_en:
The task source. Valid values:

YAO_CHI: Alibaba Cloud ApsaraDB console
parameters.help_zh:
任务来源。取值：

YAO_CHI：瑶池控制台
parameters.name: task_source

Data.description_en: The data returned when the API call is successful
Data.description_zh: 接口调用成功时，返回的数据

OperateCode.description_en:
The operation code of the cloud service configuration check task.

Throttling: rate limited
AuthorizationExhaust: insufficient authorization quota
OperateCode.description_zh:
云产品配置检测任务操作码。

Throttling：频率限制
AuthorizationExhaust：授权数不足

ThrottlingTimeSecond.description_en: The rate limit duration. Unit: seconds

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each API request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the task that runs the cloud service configuration check
TaskId.description_zh: 执行云产品配置检查的任务ID
